signIn.sessions: Card title on a person's Sign-in tab: the browsers where the person is signed in now.
signIn.signOutDevice: Accessible name of a session's Sign out button. {{device}} is a browser and system, such as "Chrome on Mac".
signIn.signOut: Button beside one session: signs the person out on that browser.
signIn.signedOut: Toast after an admin signed the person out on one browser.
signIn.by: How a session signed in, such as "by Passkey" or "by Sign-in link". {{method}} is a method's name.
signIn.lastUsed: {{ago}} is a lowercase time phrase ("now", "25 min ago", "yesterday").
signIn.since: After a session: when it started; {{date}} is a short date. Lowercase: follows a " · " separator.
signIn.nowhere: Shown when the person has no session; the _deactivated form when the account is deactivated.
signIn.app: Card title: the Socio mobile app's devices signed in to this account. "Socio" is the product name.
signIn.methods: Card title on a person's Sign-in tab: their passkeys, password and sign-in providers.
signIn.none: Muted value beside Passkeys or Sign-in providers when there are none.
signIn.passkeys: Row label in How they sign in: the person's passkeys.
signIn.passkey: Stands in for a passkey's name when it has none.
signIn.passkeyAdded: Appended to a passkey's name, starting with a comma: when it was added.
signIn.password: Row label in How they sign in: whether a password is set.
signIn.set: Value beside Password: the person has a password.
signIn.notSet: Value beside Password: the person has no password.
signIn.providers: Row label in How they sign in: outside accounts they sign in with, such as Google or Apple.
signIn.newLink: Button that makes a new link the person opens to set their password.
signIn.newestLink: Row label: the latest link made for the person to set their password, followed by its expiry.
signIn.noLink: Muted note: no password link has been made for this person yet.
owns.unknown: Shown on the Owns tab. {{first}} is the person's first name; a workspace user is made when they first sign in.
owns.loading: Shown on the Owns tab while it loads. {{first}} is the person's first name.
owns.owns: {{list}} is a comma-separated list of counted kinds ("3 schedules, 1 app").
owns.companyOwns: Muted note after the summary of what the person owns on the Owns tab.
owns.nothing: Shown on the Owns tab. {{first}} is the person's first name.
owns.transferAll: Button on the Owns tab: opens the transfer dialog for everything the person owns; the ellipsis says a dialog follows.
owns.transferKind: Accessible name of one kind's Transfer button. {{kind}} is the kind's title (Apps, Schedules…).
owns.transfer: Button on one kind's card (Apps, Schedules…): opens the transfer dialog for that kind only.
owns.deletedKept: Beside an owned item: its type, and that it was deleted but is kept.
owns.more: Under a kind's list: how many more items exist than are listed.
owns.keys: Card title: the service keys (API keys for service accounts) the person made.
owns.keysNote: Muted note beside the service keys card title. {{first}} is the person's first name. Lowercase.
owns.keysList: Accessible name of the list of service keys (API keys) the person made.
owns.neverUsed: Beside a service key the person made: it was never used. Lowercase.
owns.used: {{ago}} is a lowercase time phrase ("now", "3 days ago").
owns.noKeys: Shown on the service keys card. {{first}} is the person's first name.
activity.title: Card title on the Activity tab: the audit log lines about this person.
activity.at: When an audit trail line happened: date and time.
activity.loading: Shown while the Activity tab loads.
activity.empty: Shown on the Activity tab when the audit log has no lines about this person.
activity.more: Button under the Activity list: loads older lines.
activity.sources.workspace: Badge on an audit trail line: which part of Socio recorded it. A Room is a group chat.
activity.sources.access_policy: Badge on an audit trail line: recorded by access rules (sign-in and permissions).
activity.sources.socio_access: Badge on an audit trail line: recorded by socio access (what socios, the AI agents, may do for people).
activity.sources.room: Badge on an audit trail line: recorded by a Room (a group chat).
